summary: Iteration 71 — Deal Done / No Deal on PENDING (un-priced) submissions. Full backend + frontend verification. Backend: 8/8 pytest cases pass (test_iteration_71_deal_on_pending.py). PATCH /api/submissions/{id}/deal with {done:true} and {done:false} both succeed against a pending sub for pricing-agent dealer Dave on his owning dealership; sub.status remains 'pending' after the write; deal.done persists; purchased_at auto-stamped when done=true. GET /api/stats/deal-outcomes and /api/stats/deal-outcomes/list correctly include pending subs that carry an explicit deal.done value (verified by finding both seeded pending subs in the deal_done and no_deal bucket lists) and still exclude unmarked pending subs. Regression 403s hold: admin PATCH → 403, non-pricing-agent dealer (minitest, Karam Motors) PATCH on Dave's sub → 403, unauth → 401. Frontend (Playwright, 390x844): logged in as dave@tradeapp.co.za, opened TA-000221 (pending, un-priced) — the transfer-to-stock-card renders (previously hidden), all three outcome chips (deal-outcome-pending / done / no_deal) present and enabled, notice reads the new copy 'Transfer to stock unlocks once the full valuation is complete. You can still mark the deal outcome below.' (old subject-to-view copy no longer present anywhere in the DOM). Tapping Deal Done persists via API (deal.done=true, status still 'pending') and after full page reload the Done chip is visually active (green-tint bg) while the other two are dark. Tapping No Deal flips deal.done=false via API. Transfer to Stock button IS rendered on the card once an outcome is set but is styled disabled/greyed out because isFullyValued=false — matches spec.
action_items: No action required — feature works end-to-end. Optional polish: consider hiding the disabled 'Transfer to Stock' button entirely on pending subs (currently it renders greyed-out below the outcome chips). Not a bug, just clutter — the current behaviour matches the spec.

Housekeeping (unrelated to this iteration): /app/backend/tests/test_deal_outcomes_list.py still uses the pre-rebrand @fourbuy.co.za emails in its fixtures; those logins fail on the current DB. Suggest bulk-renaming to @tradeapp.co.za for the module fixtures next time that file is touched.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py update_submission_deal (line ~6640): correctly enforces role=dealer AND is_pricing_agent AND same dealership. No status gate exists (never did) — so removing the frontend gate on status=='pending' is safe.

server.py /stats/deal-outcomes (line ~1233): the $or query {status: {$ne:'pending'}} OR {deal.done: {$in:[True,False]}} correctly widens the scope without double-counting because each sub is evaluated once and bucketised by deal.done tri-state. Verified with the pending sub landing in deal_done / no_deal lists.

frontend TransferToStockCard.tsx line 217 keeps the Transfer button `disabled={!canTransfer || !isFullyValued}` — correct guard so pricing-not-done vehicles cannot be stock-transferred even though the deal chips are usable.

frontend vehicle/[id].tsx line 2900: `!isCoverMode && (isAdmin || isOwningDealer)` correctly renders the card for admins too. Admin's PATCH will 403 (server-side), which the UI surfaces via the standard patchDeal error path — could be pre-hidden client-side to reduce confusion but not a bug.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (all Playwright assertions pass: card visible, 3 chips present, new notice text, Deal Done persists across reload + API, No Deal flips)
